title: Concept: conda environment dependency declared without a version
description: environment.yml declares an environment dependency with no version constraint and no build string, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: conda solves to the newest matching package at create time, so two environments made from the same file differ.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through environment.yml (conda).
risk: conda solves to the newest matching package at create time, so two environments made from the same file differ.
